subject: ddl: fix cancelling stuck issue during adding index (#61544)
summary: Diff (vs first parent) only adds a new failpoint hook `beforeGetChunk` in the table-scan loop (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go`) and an ingest integration test that cancels an add-index job at that hook (`pkg/ddl/ingest/integration_test.go`), plus a Bazel shard count bump.
